summary: Iteration 25 testing completed successfully. All 14 backend tests passed (100%). Dynamic pricing page and free trial self-activation features fully functional. Pricing page fetches plans from GET /api/public/subscription-plans (public, no auth). Free trial activation via POST /api/dashboard-subscription/activate-free works correctly with duplicate prevention. Full user flow tested: Register → Pricing page → Click 'Start Free Trial' → Redirected to landing page with Dashboard button visible.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 25 verified dynamic pricing page and free trial self-activation. Key endpoints: GET /api/public/subscription-plans (public, returns active plans sorted by price), POST /api/dashboard-subscription/activate-free (auth required, activates free trial, sets dashboard_subscription_status=active, is_trial=true, trial_end_date). After free trial activation, user is redirected to landing page (/) which shows 'Dashboard' button for logged-in users. Registration flow: /login → fill form → submit → redirects to /pricing.
